intake.statement: Prove existence of absolutely continuous spectrum (delocalised states) for the random Schrodinger operator -Delta + lambda V on Z^3 at small disorder lambda, and GOE local statistics for its finite-volume restriction.

primary_source.title: Paul Bourgade, Random band matrices, ICM 2018
primary_source.read_scope: Model and Anderson/finite-volume discussion in Section 2.1 only
primary_source.model: Adjacency hopping with spectrum [-2d,2d], iid centered potentials with variance 1, disorder lambda>0; periodic finite-volume boxes and microscopic eigenvalue scaling by volume.
primary_source.short_quote: there is no clear understanding about how extended states imply GOE spectral statistics
primary_source.scope_correction: The intake contains two goals. Absolute continuity alone does not settle GOE. The source is a survey discussion, without a fully quantified universal potential-law hypothesis.
primary_source.hash_status: Recorded intake hash, not reverified against a new local download. No mathematical proof status follows from it.

working_spectral_statement.operator: H_lambda=-A+lambda V on l2(Z3), nearest-neighbor adjacency A, iid V uniform[-1,1].
working_spectral_statement.goal: There exist a deterministic nonempty open J inside (-6,6) and lambda0>0 such that for each fixed 0<lambda<lambda0, almost surely chi_J(H_lambda) is nonzero and its range is absolutely continuous.
working_spectral_statement.normalization: This uniform law has variance 1/3. The source's variance-one convention is W=sqrt(3)V and lambda_working=sqrt(3)lambda_source. Hopping signs are unitarily equivalent on Z3.
working_spectral_statement.scope: Uniform-law spectral subproblem only; no GOE or all-laws claim.

recent_primary_claim.title: Absolutely Continuous Spectrum for Weak-Disorder Anderson Models in Dimensions at Least Three
recent_primary_claim.reported_scope: For iid uniform[-1,1], every fixed sufficiently small coupling and fixed d>=3, pure AC and nonzero spectral weight on a fixed interval. The reported d=3 interval is (-6+e2/2,-6+e2), 0<e2<1/100.
recent_primary_claim.proof_verification: Full proof not audited. The statement and part of the spectral conversion were read; neither certifies the full result.
